mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS level fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The UNRATE > 5.0% condition fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS change > 0) and inflation is high (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the market experiences a 'double whammy' of monetary tightening and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS change > 0 AND CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (defined by GDP growth > 2.0% and industrial production above 100), the S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in the eventual slowdown.
failure_condition: The regime condition (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% AND INDPRO > 100) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals an impending monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL > 3.0% condition fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth is slowing (PAYEMS change < 0.5%) and unemployment is rising (UNRATE > 4.5%), the labor market deterioration signals a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (PAYEMS change < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 4.5%) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) consistently predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated housing activity signals an overheating economy that leads to monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: The HOUST level fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (defined by industrial production above 100 and housing starts below 1000), the S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions and housing market weakness weigh on economic growth.
failure_condition: The regime condition (INDPRO > 100 AND HOUST < 1000) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
